title: Development of a Novel Human In Vitro Sarcoidosis Model
brief_summary: There is currently no experimental model that accurately represents sarcoidosis. The lack of a useful research model significantly slows progress towards developing new treatments for sarcoidosis. The investigators plan to develop a new model for sarcoidosis research and will test the model to see if it helps us understand how sarcoidosis develops and if it is useful for testing new treatments.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* sarcoidosis, subjects (18 - 45 years of age), including 30 sarcoidosis, 15 latent TB and 15 healthy controls.

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnant women
